newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading of Han Joo halted after default.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Han Joo halted after default.

text.p: Trading of Han Joo, a textile company, was suspended on Monday after it defaulted on repayments of loans, the Korea Stock Exchange said.

Trading of the stock would resume on Tuesday if the company met a second and final repayment deadline by the close of Monday, it said. If Han Joo failed to meet the deadline, however, the stock would be traded on the exchange's "supervision list" from Wednesday.
Officials at Han Joo were not available for comment.
